data.action: 魔法少女变身，星尘光阵展开
data.description: 【深森白夜 · 雨中小巷·魔法少女变身与星尘阵】阴暗狭窄的雨后小巷深处，面对强大的敌人，白夜毫不犹豫地高举法杖展开耀眼的星尘变身魔法阵。绚丽的魔法光芒驱散了所有的阴霾与潮湿，她神情凛然地护在身后的人面前——「只要我还站在这里，就绝对不会允许任何人夺走大家的笑容与日常！」
data.promptProse: Byakuya raises her star-tipped wand in the narrow alley after rain, standing protectively in front of the person behind her as a stardust transformation circle opens. Her layered pink-and-white magical dress, ribbons and fairy wings remain fully clothed in the wide view. Wet walls converge beyond the opposing threat. Magic light illuminates her determined face and dress edges, with bright reflected arcs stretching across the puddles below.
data.title: 深森白夜 · 雨中小巷·魔法少女变身与星尘阵
